resources.title: Bookable resources
resources.description: Carriers book a pool or a single dock. A dock is in one pool or bookable on its own, never both.
resources.pools_off: Your package does not include pools. Existing pools keep offering times; book docks on their own instead.
resources.pool_explainer: A pool books as one unit. The dock is assigned on arrival.
resources.single_explainer: Dock {{code}} is booked on its own. To put it into a pool, choose the pool in its "Booked as" column.

fields.name: Name
fields.members_hint: Checking a dock moves it here from its current pool or single booking. A pool holds docks of one profile; a hall pool only docks of its hall.

resources.no_capacity: adds no capacity while not active
resources.lowering: Lowering capacity never cancels bookings. Bookings above the new capacity show as over capacity on the plan board.
resources.moves_from_single: booked on its own, moves here

hours.title: Weekly hours
hours.description: Wall-clock times in {{zone}}. No start time is offered outside these hours.
hours.own_hours: Own hours, narrower than the site's
hours.midnight_hint: Write 24:00 to stay open until midnight. A night shift is two windows: 22:00 to 24:00 and 00:00 to 06:00 the next day.

closures.title: Closures and public holidays
closures.description: Closures and blocks of the next 400 days. No start time is offered inside them.
closures.form_description: Close the whole site or block one resource. Times are the site's wall clock.
closures.empty: No closures in the next 400 days.
closures.holidays_off: Public holidays do not close this site: the setting "Closed on public holidays" is off.
closures.no_cancel: A closure never cancels bookings already made.

load_types.title: Load types
load_types.description: What carriers and staff book: the duration and buffer decide how long a booking holds capacity.
load_types.form_description: Durations are fixed, or tiered by load units such as pallets.
load_types.tiers_off: Your package does not include duration rules.

fields.tiers_hint: Up to how many load units each duration applies. The last tier covers everything above.
